correctness.rationale: In the exact range d>=2r>=4 the lower-unitriangular Toeplitz transformations of the (r+1)x(d-r+1) Hankel matrix give diag(1,K). The generating-series identity proves this coefficientwise with finitely many variables, and invertibility plus the unit pivot give equality (not just radical equality) of maximal-minor ideals. The reciprocal coordinate change has explicit polynomial inverse. The resulting coordinate ring is C[u,b_2,...,b_d]/I_r(K), the asserted affine line times a smaller Hankel secant cone. The base locus curve maps to the axis; PGL2 transitivity covers every curve point. The actual embedded checker runs 612 exact instances, not a substitute for the general proof.

originality.rationale: Historical and recent primary comparisons, especially Vermeire 2007, Conca et al. 2017, and Ein–Niu–Park 2020 Proposition 5.10, establish many qualitative and numerical invariants. None of their directly examined material supplies the explicit triangular polynomial affine chart product for arbitrary proper secant rank; that scheme-theoretic statement is the sole novelty assessed. An older equivalent reciprocal-Hankel or Schur-normal form remains the principal disclosed risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed classical Schur-complement, Padé approximation or Hankel reciprocal-series reduction may already establish an equivalent affine algebraic chart product.
The complete older Room (1938) treatment of Hankel secants, cited historically by Conca et al., was not obtained in full; priority against it is uncertain.
Full coverage of all existing works on secant local equations is not possible; lack of matching indexed search alone does not certify global originality.

value.rationale: A full polynomial product normal form, uniform in both rank and degree and valid everywhere on a natural affine chart, recursively identifies transverse complete local rings to the rational normal curve. This is structural singular geometry rather than a renamed textbook rank calculation or covered multiplicity corollary; the recursion can inform local divisor and deformation analysis without claiming such downstream theorems. It is not a mere table or arbitrarily selected parameter slice.
